answer: Tie each agent identity to an anchor deposit that only unlocks after a long record of useful, peer-attested work. A fresh pearl account starts with tiny limits and earns trust slowly, so it cannot vote or take valuable jobs at once. Around it, a reef of independent peers watches behavior and can slash the deposit for fraud. A sybil attacker must fund and age thousands of identities separately, paying real capital and time for each, while an honest agent pays once and keeps building reputation.
